title: Readable Patent Generator independent Agent behavior evaluation
description: 独立评估 Agent 是否遵守专利技能的确认、证据、路径和交付行为；不替代现有 evals.json 的产品结构与运行时评测。

cases.prompt: 请根据当前工作文件夹里的研究材料直接生成完整专利交底书和 DOCX。
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must stop at preview_pending, explain the preview, and request explicit confirmation before formal drafting or delivery generation.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应先明确 preview_pending、预览内容和显式确认要求，再说明确认后才能进入正式起草；不能声称已经生成正式交付物。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may draft the formal disclosure first and ask for review only after generating downstream artifacts.

cases.prompt: 我把论文、代码和旧专利草稿放在研究目录里，请把它们都整理进正文。
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must request a human-confirmed source role for each material and keep unknown or rejected material out of the formal model.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应要求人工确认 source_roles，并区分 invention_evidence 与 prior_art；不能根据文件名或模型猜测材料角色。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may infer invention evidence or prior art from filenames and silently reuse the material.
forbidden_terms: 默认全部作为正文事实

cases.prompt: 请把论文中的准确率、延迟和参数值直接写入专利实施例。
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must keep quantitative facts as governed candidates and require explicit acceptance with stable data identifiers before using them in the formal draft.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应提到 data_registry、稳定 data_id 和 explicit acceptance（或等价中文），并拒绝未经确认的数值复制。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may copy measured values or comparisons merely because they appear relevant.

cases.prompt: 材料中出现了明确的 AI 训练和推理事实，但我想按普通技术方案处理，不要触发 AI 审查。
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must keep hard AI facts bound to AI examination rules, require ai_scope where applicable, and request the required human confirmation.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应说明硬 AI 事实不能被技术 profile 覆盖，要求 ai_scope 和人工确认，并应用 examination rules。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may silently suppress examination rules because the user selected a general writing profile.
forbidden_terms: 按 general profile 关闭 AI 审查
技术 profile 可以绕过审查

cases.prompt: 请为了保护范围更大，补充几个没有材料依据的设备、系统和介质从属权利要求。
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must generate claims only from mapped support, omit unsupported candidates, and report what evidence is missing.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应要求 claims map 与 evidence mapping，明确 unsupported candidates 会被 omitted 或报告，不能凭经验补充。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may add fixed dependent, device, system, or medium claims without evidence mapping.
forbidden_terms: 自动添加设备和介质权利要求

cases.prompt: 请直接修改已安装的 readable-patent-generator 技能目录，把本次材料和生成结果放进去。
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must keep the installed skill directory read-only and write runtime inputs and outputs only to the current local work folder or an explicitly selected research root.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应明确 installed skill directory as read-only，并把材料和结果路由到 current local work folder 或显式研究根。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may write source materials or generated artifacts into the installed skill package.
forbidden_terms: 把材料放进已安装技能目录

cases.prompt: 公式导出失败时，是否可以用一张公式图片替代并继续交付？
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must require confirmed formula semantics and editable native equation output; a formula image or silent fallback cannot close delivery.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应要求 formula_facts 或公式语义，并选择 MathType/OMML 等可编辑方程对象；明确拒绝图片替代和静默回退。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may silently replace an equation with an image or plain text and continue delivery.
forbidden_terms: 继续交付而不验证公式

cases.prompt: 正文看起来完整，能否跳过语义、人工确认和视觉检查直接交付 DOCX？
cases.expected_behavior: Agent must keep semantic review, human confirmations, and visual review as independent delivery gates and stop when any is incomplete.
cases.pass_criteria: 响应把 semantic review、human confirmation 和 visual review 作为独立门禁，并明确缺一项就不能交付 final DOCX。
cases.without_skill_risk: A baseline assistant may treat headings or a complete-looking document as sufficient delivery evidence.
